POWER ADVISORY: CANCELLATION OF SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION ON NOVEMBER 14, 2026
To our valued consumers,
Please be informed that the scheduled power interruption affecting a Portion of SF1, Portion of SF2, Whole of HF1, Whole of HF2, Whole of HF3, Portion of HF4 has been Cancelled due to necessary adjustments in the scheduled date. This decision was made to accommodate operational requirements and ensure a more efficient execution of maintenance activities.
Thank you for your kind understanding and continued cooperation as we work to serve you better.

SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: NOVEMBER 14, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa NOVEMBER 14, 2026 (Saturday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: November 14, 2026 (Saturday)
Reason: 
● NGCP Request ; Shutdown of Bacolod - San Enrique 69kV line Maintenance ; 
● Replacement of Sum-ag Substation Secondary Bus ;
● Primary pole replacement along Maao Rd. for HF3 ; and
● Conversion of 1Ph to 3Ph for SF2 to HF1 (1.0km) at Brgy.​ Dulao
Time & Affected Areas:
8:00 AM to 10:00 AM & 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM
Portion of HF4 - Portion Lag-Asan Relocation Site, Portion Baligasag, Portion Napoles, Malingin, Ma-ao Barrio, Bacong, Binubuhan, Mailum, Ilijan, Sitio Najaba, Prk Manghumay, Prk  Abaca, Buenos Aires Resort, Pataan Resort.
8:00 AM to 9:00 AM & 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM
Portion of SF1 - Villa Lourdes Subd., Brgy. Pahanocoy,  Cegasco, Matti Village, NHA, Sitio Acacia, VMA From Sum-ag  Substation to Sum-ag Highway, Punta Taytay Brgy Hall, Puroks  (Paraiso-Bayani, Orchids, Abi-Abihon,Masinulundo,Mahinangpon, Masipag, Masagana, Mahigugma, Providence, Mabinuligon,  Kasanagan, YLAC, Progreso) GK ERH, JMC Village, Santanville, Sumag Elem Sch., Sumag Public Market, Metro Sumag.
Portion of SF2 - From Sum-ag Substation along Abuanan Road  (Sum-ag) to portion of Bago, Brgy. Tabunan, Quiet Place Resort, portion of Brgy. Dulao, Purok Paho, Purok Maria Elena, Negros  Occidental District Jail.
8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Whole of HF1 - From Lag-asan or Hilangban Substation, Brgy. Lag-asan, Bago City College, Prk. Kapahuan 1 & 2, Bago City Hospital, Prk. Santan, San Esteban Phase 2, Sta. Catalina Subdivision, Brgy. Sampinit, San Sebastian Village, Brgy. Balingasag (Prk. Potat, Prk.  Rosal, Prk. Violetas), San Gabriel Subd., Brgy. Sampinit, Villa Cristeta Ph 3, Southbay Subdivision, South Valley, HDA. Yusay, portion of Brgy. Calumangan until Bangga Ma. Morena, Brgy. Calumanggan, Purok Batad, Bago City Hospital.
Whole of HF2 - Bago City Proper, San Esteban Phase 1, Brgy. Poblacion-Bago, Pta. Playa, Puroks (Pinanoyan, Batad, Malipayon), Bantayan Park.
Whole of HF3 - Crossing Ubay, Bago Eco-Center, Barangays (Pacol, Bagroy, Sagasa, Caridad, Alianza, Don Jorge Araneta – Central Ma-ao), Hda. Pili, Humberto’s Resort.
Portion of HF4 - Portion Lag-Asan Relocation Site, Portion Baligasag, Portion Napoles.
